## Change

Explain the resulting behavior and why it is needed.

## Validation

- Red: command and intended failure (or explain documentation-only scope).
- Green: command, result, and regression scope.
- Device: not tested / exact hardware result; do not infer it from CI.

## Scope

- [ ] English/Japanese README and relevant docs agree.
- [ ] No credentials, recordings, firmware binaries, or private device data are included.
- [ ] Third-party license notices and the Flash refusal guard are preserved.
